messages:
Ivy Park: Quick thread — brought up rk-v3-ptq on the "sparse-short" locked holdout. NDCG@10 down ~3.0% vs prod for short queries, long-form unchanged.
Jordan Kim: Is this the new per-channel PTQ or the generic pass?
Ivy Park: Generic PTQ, default calib. Ran: ```./eval --model rk-v3-ptq --holdout holdouts/sparse-short.csv --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --seed 1234```
Pavel Orlov: Can you share per-query diffs? Might be a few anchors skewing NDCG.
Ivy Park: Uploaded diffs — majority small, ~140 queries with -0.8 to -2.5 delta. Top ones are exact-match short queries.
Jordan Kim: Try simple logit temperature scaling and a priming probe (prefix short queries with [KW]). We've seen priming recover ~2% before.
Ivy Park: Ran T=0.95 and priming probe. T=0.95 recovered 1.6%, priming recovered 2.2%.
Eval Bot: Scheduled: rerank-smoke-3501234567 (priming + temp) job queued (id: 20260301-17).
Pavel Orlov: Sounds like scoring preference shifted. Proposal: add a 'sparse-short' gate in model CI requiring <1% NDCG delta or a documented mitigation (temp, priming, or fp16-firstN).
Jordan Kim: Agreed. I'll draft the CI change. Ivy, also run fp16-first2 ablation to compare cost vs priming.
Ivy Park: On it — will post numbers when done. :thumbsup:
